name: Baranyahídvég (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and green at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Baranyahídvég (a shield of blue and green with a wagon wheel, ears of grain and a white bird) above a yellow scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
